links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT-simplified summaries versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: ChatGPT reduced reading level from about 15th grade (FKGL 15.06, SMOG 14.08) to 10th grade (FKGL 10.52, SMOG 9.48), still above the recommended sixth-grade level.
links.quote: However, the achieved 10th-grade reading level still exceeds the recommended sixth-grade level for patient education materials.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education summaries
links.effect: Summaries improved readability (P < .0001) but remained at 10th-grade level (FKGL 10.52, SMOG 9.48), above the sixth-grade target for patients.
links.quote: However, the achieved 10th-grade reading level still exceeds the recommended sixth-grade level for patient education materials.

screen.reason: The study empirically tests whether prompting an LLM with a specific reading-level constraint (sixth-grade level) successfully achieves the desired readability target while maintaining accuracy evaluated by expert clinicians.
